segments.text: We first tried Customer Relationship Management (CRM) in 208. At the time, market pressure mattered because manual reconciliation wasted staff time.
The biggest issue was Trust in vendors. Without steady power in Lagos, costs kept rising.
Our sales changed after Customer Relationship Management (CRM)—we saw Better cashflow visibility within 9 months.
Policy-wise, Import duty waivers shaped our move. We adjusted by Peer learning.
Data helped; even a moving-average model gave us clearer demand patterns during Sallah.
